label: Access score at the recommended stop
method: I take the projects in the order I picked them, and add up what each one costs and gains. The shown step is the recommended stop of the Weights as set scenario. The recipe reads that step from frontier.json; change the rank in it to check any other step.
recipe: import json;d=json.load(open('frontier.json'));s=[c for c in d['scenarios'] if c['id']=='shipped'][0];p=s['picks'][s['recommended_stop'] or 0];print(p['score'])

label: Projects up to the recommended stop
method: I divide each pick's gain by its cost plus one, using full precision. I compare it with the best ratio so far, including this pick. The stop is the last rank at least 0.25 times that best ratio, even after a weaker pick.
recipe: import json;d=json.load(open('frontier.json'));s=[c for c in d['scenarios'] if c['id']=='shipped'][0];p=s['picks'][s['recommended_stop'] or 0];print(s['recommended_stop'] or 0)
